summary: Sky Quarry Inc. filed an 8-K to disclose an amended at-the-market (ATM) sales agreement. The company replaced Cantor Fitzgerald with Muriel Siebert as the exclusive sales agent under the same shelf registration statement; the 3.0% commission and other core terms are unchanged. The maximum offering amount was increased from $4.7 million to $12.6 million. This is a routine financing facility update, not a special situation. Watch for periodic disclosures of ATM takedowns and the company's use of proceeds.
